s1216: When carrying dangerous goods, the driver is prohibited from:

s1213: Only overtaking a vehicle moving faster than 30 km/h
s1214: Only driving with the engine switched off and/or the clutch disengaged

s1217: According to paragraph 6 of Article 9 of the technical regulation "Rules for the Carriage of Goods by Motor Vehicles", approved by Order No. 1-1/1562 of the Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development of Georgia of 18 August 2011, when carrying dangerous goods, the driver is prohibited from: a) refuelling at public pumps at filling stations (when carrying explosive and flammable substances); b) starting off and braking sharply; c) overtaking a vehicle moving faster than 30 km/h; d) driving with the engine switched off and/or the clutch disengaged; e) smoking inside the vehicle; f) stopping/parking the vehicle less than 200 metres from a fire; g) leaving the vehicle unattended; h) carrying other goods and/or people who are not members of the vehicle's crew.

s1225: Is it allowed to use a gas-powered vehicle to carry dangerous goods?

s1227: Is it allowed to couple more than one trailer or semi-trailer to a vehicle when carrying dangerous goods?
s1228: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 16 of Article 9 of the technical regulation "Rules for the Carriage of Goods by Motor Vehicles", approved by Order No. 1-1/1562 of the Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development of Georgia of 18 August 2011, it is not allowed to couple more than one trailer or semi-trailer to a vehicle when carrying dangerous goods.

s1308: Which of these road signs marks a path intended for cycling that is physically separated from other roads or from other parts of the road?

s1310: Which of these road signs sets the minimum speed for driving on the road?
